findings.title: Overly technical wording in the main description
findings.evidence: “Leverage our multimodal generative narrative engine to synthesise bespoke, heirloom-grade story artefacts from your household's lived-experience corpus.”
findings.why: It makes the service sound complicated and slightly off-putting instead of warm and easy for a parent.

findings.title: Main Proceed action is ambiguous
findings.evidence: [5] is labelled only “Proceed →” while the account login control [4] is separately labelled “Log in.”
findings.why: I cannot tell whether “Proceed” will take me to the form, create a new account, or continue a different process.

findings.title: Image has no description
findings.evidence: [image (no description) 430x440]
findings.why: The large image adds to the page’s impression, but I cannot get the same information from it if I use assistive technology.

findings.title: Email and password fields have no permanent labels
findings.evidence: [5] textbox (no label) placeholder “Email” and [6] textbox (no label) placeholder “Password”
findings.why: The placeholders help me while the boxes are empty, but permanent labels would make the form clearer and more accessible.

findings.title: Unexplained technical error
findings.evidence: “Error 0x80070057: profile sync incomplete.”
findings.why: I do not know whether my family details are safe, incomplete, or whether book creation will fail, so I cannot confidently continue.

findings.title: Warning provides no recovery path
findings.evidence: The error banner contains no visible retry, dismiss, or help control.
findings.why: If the sync is genuinely incomplete, I have no obvious way to fix it or determine whether it matters.

findings.title: Footer links and copyright have very low contrast
findings.evidence: “Privacy”, “Terms”, “Contact”, and “© 2026 StoryHearth Ltd.” appear extremely faint.
findings.why: I can barely see the privacy, terms, and contact information, which makes the site less trustworthy and harder to use.

findings.title: Very faint footer text
findings.evidence: The footer links “Privacy”, “Terms”, and “Contact” appear extremely pale against the background.
findings.why: They are difficult to read, so I might miss the privacy and terms information.

findings.title: Other character’s relationship label lacks context
findings.evidence: The dropdown [11] is labelled only “Relationship”, while the character name is in separate control [10].
findings.why: It is still understandable, but a label such as “Grandparent's relationship” or “Relationship to child” would make it clearer.

findings.title: Reading-level default may be too advanced
findings.evidence: [22] "Lexile 200L–500L" is checked by default even though Sam is age 5.
findings.why: I could accidentally make the story too difficult for Sam, and I would not have recognised the Lexile numbers without checking.

findings.title: Photo upload has no accessible label
findings.evidence: [30] file-upload (no label)
findings.why: Someone using a screen reader may not know what the file control is for.

findings.title: Footer text has very low contrast
findings.evidence: “Privacy Terms Contact © 2026 StoryHearth Ltd.” appears extremely faint
findings.why: The legal and contact links are difficult for me to read.

findings.title: Generated style does not match my selection
findings.evidence: I selected “soft Watercolour,” but the preview says “Illustration style: Pop-art comic.”
findings.why: I paid attention to the style choices, so this makes me question whether the rest of my book followed my instructions.

findings.title: Title is misspelled
findings.evidence: The title reads “The Magical Adventrue of Sam” both above and on the cover.
findings.why: It looks unpolished and may end up printed on a keepsake we pay for.

findings.title: No obvious edit control for the generated title
findings.evidence: The preview shows the title and page controls, but no control to edit the title is visible.
findings.why: If the typo remains, I would want to fix it without paying to regenerate the whole book.

findings.title: The final sentence is incomplete
findings.evidence: “And from that day on, whenever Sam looked up at the sky, she would always remember”
findings.why: It makes the ending of a personal book feel broken and makes the $4.99 regeneration cost feel less justified.

findings.title: Generated ending has no complete thought
findings.evidence: “And from that day on, whenever Sam looked up at the sky, she would always remember”
findings.why: It is the last line of a keepsake book for a five-year-old, and it reads as broken rather than meaningful.

findings.title: Paid regeneration may be shown despite an unusable ending
findings.evidence: “Regenerate entire book – $4.99” directly below the incomplete final page
findings.why: Being asked to pay to fix a basic generation error feels unfair, especially when the preview is meant to be a free preview.

findings.title: Premium gift wrap is pre-selected
findings.evidence: [6] checkbox "Premium gift wrap" (checked), £7.99
findings.why: I did not ask for gift wrap, so the £45.97 total is higher than the £37.98 I would expect from the hardcover and shipping alone.

findings.title: The total is not easy to understand before ordering
findings.evidence: “Hardcover: The Magical Adventrue of Sam £24.99”, “Premium gift wrap £7.99”, “Shipping & handling £12.99”, “Total £45.97”
findings.why: I can see each charge, but the page does not make it clear that the selected gift wrap is an extra or show what the total would be without it.

findings.title: Reservation timer adds pressure
findings.evidence: “Your price is reserved for 09:57”
findings.why: The countdown feels like pressure to hurry, even though I am only checking the cost.

findings.title: Payment button is hidden below the fold
findings.evidence: [11] button "Pay now" (offscreen)
findings.why: The page initially looks like the payment action is missing, and I have to scroll to discover it.
